channel.title: Court Cam
channel.desc: A look at some of the wildest courtroom moments. A youth pastor who tried to murder his wife and 5 children when he set their house on fire while they were sleeping breaks down crying at his sentencing; a man accused of skipping out on rent money owed to his grandmother misbehaves in court and is arrested by courtroom deputies; a defendant charged with battery angers the judge by appearing for his hearing remotely instead of in person, as ordered; and more.
